Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 7
Reason for Mistake: After the Planner explicitly requested checking multiple authoritative sources (e.g., Britannica, BFI, TCM, AllMovie) to resolve birthplace discrepancies, WebSurfer repeatedly issued the same AFI site-restricted search and did not diversify or extract biographical details. This circular, unproductive behavior ignored instructions, failed to reconcile conflicting data (NYC vs. Los Angeles), and impeded reaching the correct birthplace.
